title: It’s ok
text:
Another concern: I’d love to see more variety in the Daily Prompts. Many questions have already been asked before. Refreshing the prompt library would keep journaling feeling fresh.

There are 3 features that I would love to see: highlights in other colors and not that dreadful gold, text in different colors and the ability to archive of journals. title: Last update
text:
2022: A lot of basic text editing features are missing.  No text colors, single color for highlighting.

It is been a while, but still no fix.

12/7/2025: After last update, copy/cut/paste functionality is messed up.  Cannot select more than 10 lines of text.  Practically unusable.

7/28/26 - copy/cut/paste functionality is still not fixed. You can’t copy even a few paragraphs, page starts jumping, text becomes unselected. The only work around is to go by small chunks of text.  Very annoying that it is still not fixed.
For some reason they never fix reported issues.

title: Disappointed with Day One’s AI Feature Changes
text:
I used to love Day One, but I’m really disappointed with how they handled the AI features.

When I upgraded, AI was advertised as one of the premium features. Now, those same AI features have been moved behind an even more expensive subscription tier. Existing paying customers weren’t clearly informed that something they already paid for would require another upgrade.

I’m not against companies charging for new features, but taking away or restricting features that were part of the premium experience feels misleading. A little transparency and better communication would have gone a long way.

Day One is still a beautiful journaling app, but this change has made me lose trust in the company. I hope they reconsider how they treat their loyal subscribers.

title: Missing Critical Search Within Note Feature
text:

This is really sad because it is a solid journaling app. even the free version. I've enjoyed using it quite a bit, but will probably need to leave it because if I can't search within my notes, then why type all of this information into it to begin with?

title: Why charge a lot more for what was included in premium?
text:
I really liked Day One. I’ve had it for over five years.  They recently included some Ai features that were included in my premium service. You could generate AI IMAGES from your entries, get prompts, and some great summaries for your entries., I had really been enjoying this new addition to DayOne. UNTIL TONIGHT— when those features were suddenly 
 🚫removed 🚫 from my premium membership !  NOW they made a new membership level that costs more and if you want those previously included in Premium, you have to upgrade to Silver. It really stinks that I received the AI features for a short time only to have Day One take them away. I am strongly thinking of canceling my over 5 year old membership and looking for another journaling app. Thanks a lot,DayOne. 👎🏽

title: Enjoying the update
text:
I too was originally skeptical of being forced into their sync system.  I read their terms of service and frankly some of the language was frightening, but I had a couple email exchanges with their extremely responsive customer service and I was satisfied they could not use my private entries in the future.  I've been using for two months now and their sync service is fantastic.  I had period issues with iCloud with Day One Classic, but I've never had an issue so far syncing between my iMac, iPhone, and iPad.  

The bottom line is that for YEARS I struggled to consistently journal - since getting Dayone in 2012, and now Dayone 2 - I journal more than I have in my entire life.  It is awesome for capturing moments and recording my life.  I know some day there won't be a price you can put on having these entries.  It's so easy to capture photos in DayOne 2 and being able to have multiple photos in an entry is awesome.  

If your nervous about their sync, just read the news, it's a risk we all take using the cloud, but to me the trade off is that I'm building a lifetime of memories with this app.

Update MANY years later - I wrote the above a long time ago. I’ve been using this app daily and haven’t missed a day since 2015. The new conversation element is amazing to me. It helps me journal throughout the day more instead of trying to remember the whole day. Quite frankly the AI asks some very insightful questions that help me go deeper and have really improved my entries. I’m hoping eventually they will add the ability to use AI to “converse” with your older entires like “hey how did I handle this previously . . . “.

UPDATE 6/11/2026 - after giving original plus members (I’ve been using the journal since 2012) the daily chat for about the last 8 months the tiers changed with no notice or warning.  Went to use it today and see now I’m “silver” and have to upgrade to use it. I get it, apps need to make money but it’s a shame is the same old methods - hook you on the service for some indefinite period of time then take it away.  Not a lot of loyalty for long time subscribers.  I feel like that is disappointing. Even changing the tiers and not keeping it the same. Might be time to look for other options or use apples.

Really a shame they just don’t have as much loyalty toward their subscribers and users that have been here since well Day One.  Pun intended.  Their latest bait and switch on features I just thought was a really poor thing to do. Gave the use of chat for like 8 months then raised the price of the tier I was on and decided to take away the features.  I was using the chat in beta. Very disappointed and a little sad to have to login for another option.
